## File: huggingface_transformers/src/transformers/models/bert_japanese/tokenization_bert_japanese.py

Prompts

```
['build a BertJapaneseTokenizer instance with mecab word tokenization and wordpiece subword tokenization for Japanese text', 'create a MecabTokenizer with fugashi and a specified dictionary for Japanese morphological tokenization', 'create a SudachiTokenizer with sudachipy and a configurable split mode A, B, or C for Japanese text', 'create a JumanppTokenizer with rhoknp for Japanese morphological tokenization', 'test the WordpieceTokenizer with a vocabulary to split tokens into word pieces using greedy longest-match-first']
```

Usage

```
{'build_japanese_bert_tokenizer': 'build a BertJapaneseTokenizer instance with mecab word tokenization and wordpiece subword tokenization for Japanese text', 'create_mecab_tokenizer': 'create a MecabTokenizer with fugashi and a specified dictionary for Japanese morphological tokenization', 'create_sudachi_tokenizer': 'create a SudachiTokenizer with sudachipy and a configurable split mode A, B, or C for Japanese text', 'create_jumanpp_tokenizer': 'create a JumanppTokenizer with rhoknp for Japanese morphological tokenization', 'test_wordpiece_tokenizer': 'test the WordpieceTokenizer with a vocabulary to split tokens into word pieces using greedy longest-match-first'}
```
